title: Security audit follow-up hardening
summary: Hardened GitHub workflow execution, restored CI release/package runtime expectations without weakening package validation, resolved Ruff undefined-name/export findings, and tightened Local API/WebView URL/path handling. Documented the deferred glib upstream risk and planned core/desktop architecture cleanup.
reason: Address security audit issues #20, #22, #24, and #25 while keeping #15 and #23 tracked with explicit disposition instead of broad unsafe dependency or architecture changes.
behavior_before: Some workflows interpolated GitHub context values directly in run blocks, phase1 drift lacked explicit workflow permissions, CI release/package jobs expected bundled Python paths that are absent on hosted runners, Ruff reported undefined annotation/export names, and WebView API calls accepted caller-supplied paths into fetch URL construction without a local API route allowlist.
behavior_after: Workflows use explicit permissions and environment-mediated validated inputs in run blocks, CI release/package jobs provision the expected bundled Python runtime layout before strict validation, Ruff F821/F822/F823 is clean for src/tests, static asset paths reject decoded traversal, and WebView API calls are limited to loopback Local API origins plus /api/ routes before fetch.
manual_validation: Initialize-CiPythonRuntime.ps1 -PythonExe apps/desktop/runtime/Python/python.exe - passed; existing runtime targets detected
PowerShell parse check for Initialize-CiPythonRuntime.ps1 and check-github-audit-spine.ps1 - passed
git diff --check on touched paths - passed (line-ending warnings only)
ruff check --select F821,F822,F823 src tests - passed
validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage - failed: 423 pre-existing/unrelated changed files are not listed in any unreleased change packet
rollback_plan: Revert the workflow hardening, CI runtime bootstrap script, Ruff import/export adjustments, Local API/WebView URL/path changes, associated tests, refreshed summaries, and documentation disposition updates. If CI runtime provisioning is reverted, release/package CI jobs will again require a separate bundled-runtime provisioning decision.
notes:
Hardened workflow permissions, GitHub expression handling, private beta input validation, and CI runtime provisioning.
Added CI bundled-Python runtime bootstrap and updated audit-spine/root-script inventories.
Hardened Local API asset path decoding and WebView API URL/path normalization.
Resolved Ruff undefined-name and shim-export findings without changing runtime policy.
Added regression coverage for decoded asset traversal, API path normalization, and escaped glob regex construction.
Recorded #15/#20/#22/#23/#24/#25 issue dispositions in active status docs.
Refreshed generated summaries for changed source, script, workflow, and test files.
